campaign_policy.objective: Review the new full-vocabulary common-history GPU diagnostic. Independently verify the retained50-token pair using numerical_investigation_lab.first_divergence; use evidence_digest_lab to obtain exact relevant report fields with limitations and source hashes. Decide what the evidence establishes and what remains unknown. Use the branch workbench for a justified next investigation; do not manufacture branching or prune for a quota. Propose the cheapest discriminating next test and its stop condition. Preserve observer effects, no quality or speed acceptance, and do not guess a layer-level cause. Publish a concise final report as an immutable observation with the next-input proposal rather than relying on local file writes. Stay within this CPU evidence-review task; do not run engines/builds or modify source.
